name: @qontinui/cloud-control
description: Cloud extension to qontinui-web — powers the qontinui.cloud deployment (billing, multi-tenant routing, cloud-admin). AGPL-3.0; not published to npm (consumed as a file: path dependency).
//: No `test` script on purpose: the previous `vitest run` could not run (vitest was not a dependency, and neither a config nor a test file existed). A JS suite here needs the host app's `@/*` alias graph, since this package compiles inside qontinui-web. See .qontinui/ci.toml. The scripts/ gates are tested by `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts`.
//exports: No `exports` map on purpose. `main` alone is what qontinui-web's dynamic `import("@qontinui/cloud-control")` resolves, and adding `exports` would ALSO make it an encapsulation boundary that hides every subpath not listed. Wildcard targets do no extension resolution either, so a single `./services/*` pattern cannot serve both .ts and .tsx. Add explicit entries when a real deep-import consumer appears; today there are none, only prose references in qontinui-web comments.
